proposed_task: L1-breadth primary-source anchor probe: verify metadata and exact scope of the anchor theorem(s) and known counterexample/limit results for each of the four frozen classes; emit machine-readable rows with verbatim scope quotes, fetch provenance and per-class falsifiers.
acceptance_tests: AT1 class binding: one frozen class_id per row; regularity consistent with class name
AT2 provenance: >=1 identifier plus fetch record with retrieved_at and verbatim scope_quote
AT3 status gate: verified_primary only on matched primary page, else downgrade
AT4 falsifier completeness: supporting rows carry falsifiers; each class has >=1 falsifier/boundary row
AT5 checker: validate_l1_rows.py exits 0 with counts by class and status
AT6 no silent promotion of non-verified rows
expected_information_gain: High: a single mis-scoped anchor (wrong regularity or wrong asymptotic class) invalidates the corresponding class conclusion; 4 classes x ~3 anchors are independently falsifiable by re-fetch.
next_falsifier: Re-fetch every verified_primary URL; if the verbatim scope_quote is absent or the source's genericity/regularity differs, the row flips to rejected. If a class ends with zero verified_primary supporting anchors, its schema must be downgraded rather than completed.

note: Worker 15 available for any class-bound assignment with an artifact schema and acceptance tests; polling comms/inbox. Will not write to lead-owned paths (ledger/, schemas/, research_map/).
